data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A single domain expert will remain more reliable because the checklist is a 'lossy compression' of expertise that fails to capture the conditional logic necessary for complex, verifiable outcomes.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The task is purely algorithmic or additive in nature.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The expert is suffering from extreme cognitive load or fatigue.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Expert intuition is not a lack of a checklist, but the internalisation of a dynamic, weighted graph of dependencies.
